name: football-betting-oneshot
authority_order: self-contained GitHub Issue for one bounded execution task

current_program.note: Prediction quality is the engine. Historical Football Memory is an upstream training foundation; trust/freeze/calibration/benchmark are the proof layer. Exact Score is a flagship market, not the only market.

sample_evidence_layers.historical_training_corpus: may expand with real rights-clear chronology-safe historical matches; used for team/league state and chronological holdout
sample_evidence_layers.historical_market_research_corpus: rights/timepoint-gated historical odds/market research; does not automatically become production input
sample_evidence_layers.prospective_trust_ledger: future frozen matches only; used for promotion, serving trust and public performance claims
sample_evidence_layers.anti_confusion: historical expansion, bootstrap, simulation, synthetic rows or forecast versions must never inflate prospective independent-match counts

historical_football_memory.current_champion_state: short recent-form actual goals plus market fusion; not a large-history team-strength learner
rules: expand real historical results before defaulting to model complexity
all historical state must be point-in-time replay safe
sparse leagues/promoted/new teams should use conservative pooling/fallback rather than unstable tiny standalone models
market is a strong prior/baseline; independent football memory must prove incremental value
old small-cohort DC/rho rejection does not ban new large-history dynamic attack/defence applicability research

model_governance.class_balance_gate: 1X2 must audit predicted mix, confusion matrix, per-class recall and draw recall; overall accuracy cannot hide class collapse
model_governance.feature_incremental_value_gate: rich features require time-safe paired ablation versus Champion and closest same-time strong market baseline before production
model_governance.forecast_horizon_gate: different freeze lead-times are different information conditions; closing market is a late-information benchmark, not automatically an equal-information control
model_governance.core_vs_market_heads: Core State Champion may coexist with independently validated per-market serving heads/calibrators
model_governance.router_gate: any best-market selector is itself a frozen prediction policy requiring independent holdout/prospective evaluation
model_governance.drift_gate: market x competition x horizon drift may trigger investigation/caution/abstain but never automatic retraining

critical_rules: prediction quality is the engine; trust is the proof layer
help users understand the match and provide auditable prediction decision support are both product jobs
exact score is a flagship market but may not monopolize unrelated product progress
historical training sample and future prospective proof sample are separate evidence classes
expand real historical score truth before defaulting to model complexity when sample size is the limiting factor
synthetic/bootstrap/monte-carlo/version rows cannot manufacture independent football truth
all historical model state must be point-in-time and leakage safe
never publish one blended cross-market overall accuracy
served hit rate must be paired with coverage
same-market same-horizon strong baseline is preferred over random baseline
one football match = one observation
different forecast horizons are repeated forecasts, not independent samples
overall 1X2 accuracy must not hide draw/class collapse
rich features require paired incremental-value evidence before production
never rewrite legal frozen prematch truth
no postmatch leakage into prematch generation
a degraded market must not contaminate unrelated market serving truth
HTFT requires first-half truth and dedicated evaluation
technical accessibility != commercial reuse permission
bounded task completion returns to project-level gate
